CardDeck.description: The only OpenUI root. Lays out GeneratedCard peers as a horizontal snap deck in narrow containers and a responsive grid in wide containers.

GeneratedCard.signature: GeneratedCard(cardId: string, title: string, children: any[], variant?: "standard" | "hero" | "editorial" | "comparison" | "timeline" | "data" | "action" | "media", density?: "compact" | "balanced" | "immersive", subtitle?: string)
GeneratedCard.description: One peer card in a CardDeck. The host supplies cardId and title; compose its children freely without adding another card boundary.

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy".

Stack.signature: Stack(children: any[], direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
Stack.description: Flex container. direction: "row"|"column" (default "column"). gap: "none"|"xs"|"s"|"m"|"l"|"xl"|"2xl" (default "m"). align: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"baseline". justify: "start"|"center"|"end"|"between"|"around"|"evenly".

Callout.signature: Callout(variant: "info" | "warning" | "error" | "success" | "neutral", title: string, description: string, visible?: $binding<boolean>)
Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TagBlock.description: tags is an array of strings

StepsItem.description: title and details text for one step

TabItem.signature: TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | Steps)[])
TabItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components

Timeline.signature: Timeline(items: {title: string, detail?: string, meta?: string}[])
Timeline.description: A chronological or sequential set of milestones with optional detail and metadata.

MetricRow.signature: MetricRow(items: {label: string, value: string, detail?: string}[])
MetricRow.description: A compact row of key metrics. Prefer this over manually stacking labels and values.

MediaHero.signature: MediaHero(title: string, subtitle?: string, assetRef?: string, badges?: string[])
MediaHero.description: A prominent editorial hero with an optional host-owned assetRef. Never pass a URL.

AssetImage.description: Displays a host-resolved image by assetRef. assetRef must come from availableAssets; never pass a URL.

AssetGallery.description: Displays host-resolved image IDs as a two- or three-column gallery. Never pass URLs.

ActionPanel.signature: ActionPanel(title?: string, description?: string, actions: (HostActionChip | HostActionItem)[])
ActionPanel.description: A focused host-action region. Its children must be supplied HostActionChip or HostActionItem refs.

HostActionChip.description: Compact host-side action affordance. actionRef must be copied exactly from CardPlan Markdown.

HostActionItem.signature: HostActionItem(label: string, actionRef: string, description?: string)
HostActionItem.description: A host-side action rendered as a descriptive list or menu row.

componentGroups.name: Prompt Capability Palette
notes: GeneratedCard is the only peer-card boundary.
